source_window: Original 1647 PDF398–400 / printed364–366 before Chapter LI divider

units.source_statement: A printed unnumbered heading Who the Thiefe is opens possible household familiarity rules.
preconditions: Begins above the separate heading A stranger and the direction table.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: These are speculative claims, not identification of a real offender.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon both beholding ascendant together are read as implying a familiar of the house.
preconditions: Both luminaries aspect the ascendant at one time.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not infer a real household culprit.

units.source_statement: Ascendant lord joined to seventh lord in ascendant is another alleged indication of a familiar.
preconditions: Both designated lords conjoined in first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The same configuration is used for different outcomes in other chapters; scope is local.

units.source_statement: Lilly says Sun and Moon in Leo or Cancer, or in first or in house of ascendant lord and beholding it, may signify someone well known but not belonging to the family.
preconditions: The source supplies multiple alternatives around the luminaries and signs.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Compound syntax is ambiguous; preserve alternatives rather than a unique psychological identity.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord in eighth or twelfth is listed among conditions for a person known but not of the family.
preconditions: Specific seventh-house ruler in eighth or twelfth.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No evidence of real friendship or criminal conduct.

units.source_statement: Sun or Moon in exaltation appears among indications of an acquaintance who is not a family member.
preconditions: Relevant luminary in own exaltation.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Distinguish from the later 'terms or faces' rule.

units.source_statement: Luminaries in their terms or faces are said to indicate one known to the household but not of the family.
preconditions: Sun or Moon has term/face dignity as source requires.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Don't equate 'household' and 'family'.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord situated in seventh is separately claimed to indicate someone of the household.
preconditions: The alleged thief's seventh lord occupies its own seventh house.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is authorial historical testimony only.

units.source_statement: The heading A stranger introduces conditions offered for identifying an outsider rather than family or household person.
preconditions: Comes after the familiar/household alternatives.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Neither positive nor negative results establish a suspect.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord in the third or ninth counted from his own house is said to indicate a stranger.
preconditions: Turned-house third/ninth from seventh, rather than necessarily the radical third/ninth.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The printed 'from his house' requires interpreting turning correctly; preserve ambiguity.

units.source_statement: If first lord and seventh lord do not belong to one triplicity, Lilly gives another outsider indication.
preconditions: The two planetary significators are not of one triplicity.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source's definition of lord 'of one triplicity' is not independently specified.

units.source_statement: When a person is deemed domestic, Lilly offers a planetary role list of supposed household relations.
preconditions: Domestic conclusion is already established in the source's chart method.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a way to diagnose a real person's relationship or guilt.

units.source_statement: Sun is associated with father or master of household in the printed domestic-person list.
preconditions: Sun occupies the specified role in this secondary classification.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Historical household stereotype.

units.source_statement: Moon is associated with mother or mistress in the domestic-person list.
preconditions: Moon relevant to the role.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a real accusation against any mother.

units.source_statement: Venus is associated with a wife or woman.
preconditions: Venus relevant.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a verified woman or spouse.

units.source_statement: Saturn is described as a servant or a stranger lying there by chance.
preconditions: Saturn relevant to domestic category.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The source itself gives two disjunct possibilities.

units.source_statement: Mars is associated with a son, brother or kinsman.
preconditions: Mars relevant to domestic category.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Keep each role alternative.

units.source_statement: Mercury is associated with a youth, familiar or friend.
preconditions: Mercury relevant.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No biographical knowledge inferred.

units.source_statement: The printed heading Whither is the Thief gone, or Fugitive begins a location-direction inquiry.
preconditions: After domestic/stranger classification.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source directions are hypotheses, not actual tracking.

units.source_statement: Lilly calls ascendant, or a planet significant within it, East as primary anchor for the listed house directions.
preconditions: Ascendant or selected significator in first house.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The same subsection says its table provides fuller quarters.

units.source_statement: One 12-house direction table assigns first east, seventh west, fourth north and tenth south, with intermediary quarters for other houses.
preconditions: Use the exact house indicated by the fugitive significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Twelve table rows appear in PRINTED_DIRECTION_TABLES.json and original PDF398 image. Printed table isn't independently validated.

units.source_statement: Printed heading The Signes introduces two parallel tables of zodiac sign to direction.
preconditions: The relevant zodiac sign must be identified.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The printed pair shows small differences and the margin says use what seems true; keep both.

units.source_statement: First printed table assigns Aries east, Cancer full north, Libra full west, Capricorn full south and intercardinal directions to eight remaining signs.
preconditions: Select the relevant sign; use the original table's direction, not interpolated compass bearing.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Twelve rows in PRINTED_DIRECTION_TABLES.json; source page is authority.

units.source_statement: Second printed table uses zodiac glyphs and slightly different intercardinal descriptions including Leo northeast-by-east and Taurus southeast-by-south.
preconditions: Use the second printed table as a DISTINCT competing method.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not silently choose whichever table fits an observed location.

units.source_statement: Printed margin acknowledges the small differences between two tables and advises readers to use whichever they find most true.
preconditions: Both original zodiac direction tables must be compared.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is explicit flexible selection with empirical overfitting risk; not a consensus direction.

units.source_statement: A printed heading The flight of the Thiefe introduces flight-speed interpretation.
preconditions: Apply only to alleged fugitive's selected significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not geographic tracking of a real offender.

units.source_statement: The alleged thief is described as fleeing swiftly when his significator moves swiftly.
preconditions: Thief significator swift in motion.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Requires relative planetary motion from an actual historic chart, not just sign.

units.source_statement: Joining to other planets swift in motion is another claimed flight-speed condition.
preconditions: Thief significator joined to a swift-moving planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Separate from sign-based modality.

units.source_statement: Significator in movable signs or signs of short ascensions is likewise associated with swift flight.
preconditions: The relevant significator's sign must be movable or short-ascension.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The two sign categories are alternative criteria and their location/latitude convention is unverified.

units.source_statement: A distinct heading His flight is uncertaine introduces a separate alternative.
preconditions: Distinguished from swift and slow conditions.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: A class of uncertain prediction, not an observed evasive manoeuvre.

units.source_statement: Significators in their second station are said to imply uncertain movement.
preconditions: Second, NOT first station.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: House and station conditions shouldn't be conflated.

units.source_statement: Joined to stationary planets in angles or succedents also yields an uncertain flight claim.
preconditions: A stationary planet joined and placed angular/succedent.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Don't reduce to any stationary planet anywhere.

units.source_statement: A heading He makes slow haste introduces a slower category.
preconditions: Contrast with movable/short-ascension swift flight.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No measured travel speed.

units.source_statement: Slow significator or conjunction to slow planets is said to make the alleged thief move slowly.
preconditions: The thief's planet is slow, or joined to a slow-moving planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This may overlap second-station uncertainty; preserve labels.

units.source_statement: Significator in a fixed sign or sign of long ascensions is said to mean slow flight.
preconditions: Fixed modality or long-ascension sign.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No modern timing calibration.

units.source_statement: A new heading He shall be taken introduces a series of alternative alleged capture configurations.
preconditions: These are historical source rules, not criminal-investigative evidence.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source sentence runs into next page for negative capture exceptions.

units.source_statement: First-house lord in seventh, or conjoined with seventh-house lord, is given as an alleged capture condition.
preconditions: Specific first-to-seventh physical placement or conjunction.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Does not demonstrate apprehension.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord in first or joined to first lord is another capture indication.
preconditions: Seventh-house significator in first or conjoined with first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Treat as alternative to first lord in seventh.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord joined to a retrograde planet is another claimed capture condition; this is separate from the seventh lord being in the first or joined to the first lord.
preconditions: Printed PDF399/365: 'or a Retrograde Planet' follows 'joyned to the Lord of the first'; whether coordinated as an object of the seventh lord's joining is grammatically implied, not independently verified.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Historical allegation only. Do not require first-house placement in the retrograde branch without the source saying so.

units.source_statement: Moon separating from the lord of the seventh and moving to conjunction with the lord of the first is offered as a capture testimony.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the Moon separate from the lord of the seventh, to the conjunction of the lord of the first'.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Moon-in-seventh square Mars belongs to a DIFFERENT additional capture list on PDF400; it was wrongly copied here in the earlier producer draft.

units.source_statement: Moon separating from the conjunction of the lord of the first toward the lord of the seventh is a separate historical capture indication.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or from the conjunction of the lord of the first to the lord of the seventh'; the exact aspect of its final contact with seventh lord is not specified.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The old draft erroneously imported a Moon/Saturn/Mercury/Sun square condition from next-page PDF400.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon in conjunction with the lord of the seventh, or in a variant reading beholding him, are cited as historical capture indications.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if Sun and Moon be in conjunction with the lord of the seventh, some say, if they behold him'.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The source's 'some say' offers a qualified alternate aspect criterion; keep source uncertainty. Moon in sixth/eighth/twelfth is on PDF400, not this page.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord going to conjunction with the Sun, described as combustion, is presented as a historical capture condition.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the lord of the seventh be going to conjunction, viz. Combustion'.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The prior Saturn/Mercury progression is on PDF400. The source does not specify exact orbs/timing.

units.source_statement: Lilly adds an obscure condition of the ascendant lord being in conjunction in the ascendant, tenth or seventh, OR an unfortunate planet in the seventh, as further capture indicators.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the lord of the ascendant be in conjunction in the ascendant, tenth or seventh, or an infortunate Planet in the seventh'.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The conjunction's other party is unspecified in this printed phrase; do not invent one. Moon-eighth/Mars-second is separately on PDF400.

units.source_statement: The heading Not taken begins an explicit escape/noncapture exception section.
preconditions: Below page turn from captured list.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Must not conflate with every Fortune contact being favorable to capture.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord aspecting a Fortune is offered as a noncapture testimony.
preconditions: Seventh lord with a benefic configuration.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The following qualifying branches describe escape aided by others.

units.source_statement: If the Fortune involved is Jupiter or Venus in eleventh, escape is attributed to friends.
preconditions: Jupiter/Venus and eleventh-house location must be checked.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source explanation is hypothetical; no actual aiding friend established.

units.source_statement: If Jupiter/Venus occupies third instead, the author attributes escape to strangers.
preconditions: Same Fortune in third, not eleventh.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Distinct from the friend assistance condition.

units.source_statement: Separate printed heading The Goods restored begins restitution rather than offender capture rules.
preconditions: Original PDF400 upper.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No empirical recovered goods case.

units.source_statement: Lord of first OR second in conjunction with eighth lord is a claimed return-of-goods condition.
preconditions: One specified owner/goods lord joined to eighth lord.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Contradicts some earlier eighth-related no-recovery readings, preserved separately.

units.source_statement: Strong reception involving these goods or owner rulers is also described as hopeful for restoration.
preconditions: Specific house lords/ruler reception.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Reception is not a sufficient empirical probability.

units.source_statement: Second-house lord departing from combustion is said to support recovery.
preconditions: Second lord LEAVING combustion, not combust.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This reverses the negative combust-source rule.

units.source_statement: Sun OR Moon in first or tenth is an additional good-restitution claim.
preconditions: The source lists the luminaries and houses as alternatives.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Does not require Sun and Moon conjunct; exact coordination ambiguous.

units.source_statement: When the recovery luminaries are strong, the author says most of the goods may return.
preconditions: Strong luminaries and favorable prior restitution condition.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source says ‘the most part’, not all.

units.source_statement: When the luminaries are weak, less of the lost goods is said to return.
preconditions: Weak significators/lights.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Historically suggested fractional outcome, not measured.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon in some aspect, especially when angular, give hope of restitution.
preconditions: The two lights aspect one another under described conditions.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source lists first/seventh/eighth lords separately; keep scope ambiguous.

units.source_statement: Lord of seventh or eighth is listed as additional testimony in goods-restored passage.
preconditions: A named relation involving seventh/eighth lords, incomplete in printed fragment.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No invented missing predicate.
PDF400/366 has an elliptical trailing clause 'or the lord of the seventh or eighth'; do not construe either ruler alone as a fully stated sufficient condition.

units.source_statement: Heading No Restitution opens adverse rules for loss.
preconditions: Keep it separate from capture and return claims.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source statements are not verified case studies.

units.source_statement: Second-house lord combust is said to indicate no restitution.
preconditions: Second lord within combustion condition.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Opposes ‘departing from combustion’ success passage above.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord joined by conjunction with eighth lord is an adverse restitution condition.
preconditions: Lord7 joined to lord8.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a generic seventh-house malefic.

units.source_statement: Second lord not beholding the first house or its lord is listed as no-restoration testimony.
preconditions: No aspect from goods' lord to first cusp or ruler.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Different from earlier positive reception.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon not mutually aspecting are listed among no restitution signs.
preconditions: Absence of Sun–Moon aspect.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not equivalent to both being below the earth.

units.source_statement: Part of Fortune and/or both lights below earth are listed as adverse; syntactic grouping is uncertain.
preconditions: Check glyph and scope of 'when both under earth'.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Keep any ambiguity, don't invent which two are involved.

units.source_statement: The heading Other Rules that the Thiefe shall be taken opens an additional compact list.
preconditions: Occurs immediately before Chapter LI divider.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: List should be transcribed as source data, not police guidance.

units.source_statement: Moon in seventh applying to eighth lord is an alleged capture condition.
preconditions: Moon in seventh, applying to eighth ruler.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Application to l8 specifically, not a generic aspect.

units.source_statement: First lord situated in ascendant is separately on the capture list.
preconditions: First-house ruler in first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not evidence of criminal guilt.

units.source_statement: Moon in seventh applying by square to Mars is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Moon in seventh, directed square to Mars.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: An authorial repetition of p399, not new observed support.

units.source_statement: Moon separating from square Saturn or Mercury then applying to square Sun is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Ordered past-to-future square configurations.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source symbols may be hard to distinguish; original image prevails.

units.source_statement: Moon in sixth, eighth or twelfth is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Moon in one of three houses.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a second observed capture outcome.

units.source_statement: Seventh lord in first is included as an extra capture condition.
preconditions: Thief's significator in first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: A source repetition from p399.

units.source_statement: Moon separating from Saturn conjunction and applying to Mercury square is one of the printed combinations.
preconditions: Directed lunar separation/application.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Adjacent first-house ruler/seventh-house ruler placement may also be required.

units.source_statement: The printed final capture-list clause places the Moon in the eighth house IN OPPOSITION (☍) to Mars in the second house; it does not prescribe conjunction.
preconditions: Original PDF400/printed366 at the last line above Chapter LI: Moon in eighth, opposition (☍) to Mars in second. This is a historical author's statement only.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The prior producer misread the opposition ☍ glyph as conjunction ☌ and inferred a false geometry conflict. No observed outcome or independent astrological validity follows.
units.original_page_anchor: ☽ In the eight, in ☍ to ♂ in the second.

units.source_statement: Horizontal divider closes Chapter L on original PDF400 / printed366; Chapter LI Of Battell, Warre, or other Contentions begins below it.
preconditions: All above-divider Chapter L text included; below divider excluded.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No case/evidence drawn from Chapter LI.
